notes: Curated list for the OWNED journal. notable_examples are illustrative, not exhaustive ('historic' = exited). aum_approx values are rounded public figures (as of aum_as_of) and should be verified before citing. link_check records the HTTP status at generation time; logo.source 'favicon-service' means the site logo could not be fetched and a favicon was used instead.

types.buyout: Private equity firm acquiring control stakes, often with debt.
types.growth: Growth-equity / crossover investor taking minority stakes in scaling companies.
types.venture: Venture capital firm funding early- and mid-stage companies for minority stakes.
types.corporate-venture: Investment arm of an operating company, often with strategic aims.
types.multi-strategy: Alternative asset manager running PE alongside credit, real estate, etc.
types.sovereign-wealth: State-owned investor; fund LP and direct co-investor.

investors.name: Hg
investors.focus: European and transatlantic software and tech-enabled services; majority and minority stakes.

investors.name: KKR
investors.focus: Global multi-asset investor; large technology buyout and tech growth practice.

investors.name: Blackstone
investors.focus: World's largest alternative asset manager; corporate PE, growth equity and real estate.

investors.name: Hellman & Friedman
investors.focus: Large-cap buyouts in software, financial services, healthcare and consumer.

investors.name: Silver Lake
investors.focus: Technology-focused large-scale investing.

investors.name: Bain Capital
investors.focus: Multi-asset investor with dedicated tech buyout and venture (Bain Capital Ventures) arms.

investors.name: Cinven
investors.focus: European buyouts across TMT, business services, healthcare and financial services.

investors.name: CVC Capital Partners
investors.focus: European and Asian buyouts; separate growth (tech) strategy.

investors.name: TPG
investors.focus: Global PE with TPG Capital, TPG Growth and TPG Rise; major tech practice.

investors.name: Vista Equity Partners
investors.focus: Enterprise software exclusively; known for a codified operating playbook.

investors.name: Thoma Bravo
investors.focus: Software and technology buyouts; the largest software-focused PE firm.

investors.name: EQT
investors.focus: Nordic-rooted global investor with thematic, digitisation-led ownership model.

investors.name: Permira
investors.focus: European and US buyouts and growth equity; strong technology sector.

investors.name: Advent International
investors.focus: Global buyouts across business services, healthcare, industrials, retail and technology.

investors.name: Warburg Pincus
investors.focus: Growth-oriented global PE across technology, financial services, healthcare.

investors.name: Francisco Partners
investors.focus: Technology and tech-enabled businesses, including carve-outs.

investors.name: The Carlyle Group
investors.focus: Global multi-asset manager with corporate PE, including technology.

investors.name: Apax Partners
investors.focus: Tech, services, healthcare and internet/consumer; dedicated Apax Digital growth fund.

investors.name: Nordic Capital
investors.focus: Healthcare, technology & payments, financial services in Europe and North America.

investors.name: Bridgepoint
investors.focus: European mid-market buyouts and growth; publicly listed manager.

investors.name: Apollo Global Management
investors.focus: Credit-heavy alternative manager; large-cap and distressed PE.

investors.name: ICG (Intermediate Capital Group)
investors.focus: Listed alternative manager spanning structured and private equity, private debt and real assets.

investors.name: Montagu Private Equity
investors.focus: European mid-market buyouts in software, healthcare data and business-critical services.

investors.name: GIC
investors.focus: Singapore's sovereign wealth fund; invests as LP in PE funds and directly alongside sponsors.

investors.name: Insight Partners
investors.focus: Software ScaleUp investing from early growth to buyout; Insight Onsite operator team.

investors.name: General Atlantic
investors.focus: Global growth equity in technology, financial services, healthcare, consumer.

investors.name: Summit Partners

investors.name: TA Associates
investors.focus: Growth-oriented PE in technology, healthcare, financial and business services.

investors.name: Tiger Global Management

investors.name: SoftBank Vision Fund
investors.focus: Mega-round late-stage tech investing, backed by SoftBank Group.

investors.name: Andreessen Horowitz (a16z)

investors.name: Sequoia Capital

investors.name: Accel

investors.name: Balderton Capital

investors.name: Lightspeed Venture Partners
